Hardware (not software) of empathy. Expect surprises (not disappointments). Swimming alongside (not against) the boat. ④ correct.

Mirror neurons are the hardware of ____. The passage is about empathy via mirror neurons. ④ empathy.
Animals possess similar brain ____. Brain mechanisms is the natural collocation. ③ mechanisms.
See things from the ____ of others. From the perspective of is a fixed phrase. ③ perspective.
possess = to own/have. ①lose antonym. ②reject unrelated. ③destroy unrelated. ④have = synonym.
speculate = form opinions without evidence. ①confirm antonym. ②deny unrelated. ③guess = synonym. ④ignore unrelated.
assume = suppose/presume. ①doubt antonym. ②suppose = synonym. ③deny antonym. ④forget unrelated.
similar = alike. Antonym is different. ①alike synonym. ②different antonym. ③comparable synonym. ④related synonym.
publicly = openly. Antonym is privately. ①openly synonym. ②officially similar nuance. ③privately antonym. ④honestly unrelated.

The ability to understand and share the feelings of another = empathy. ①sympathy = compassion. ②apathy = indifference. ③antipathy = dislike. ④empathy correct.
Scientists often publicly ____ (speculate). Plural subject + present tense habitual = base form. speculate (no -s for plural).
from the ____ (perspective) of others. After the, noun needed. perspective is already a noun, no change needed.
